caption:
Left my script pad open for ten minutes and got replaced. 

My seven-year-old decided my dialogue was too slow and pitched a three-frame sequence involving a "laser-dog." 

Honestly, his framing is bolder than mine. Might have to option this.
topic: My seven-year-old son's attempt at storyboarding a superhero sequence on my script pad
format: Single image of a crayon sketch on a script page side-by-side with my actual script binder
